name: tradeguard-shield
description: Real-time API and browser extension for checking the legitimacy and risk level of trading websites.
author: Ciprian Ștefan Pleșca

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tradeguard/shared build && pnpm --filter @tradeguard/api build && pnpm --filter @tradeguard/extension build && pnpm --filter @tradeguard/dashboard build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tradeguard/shared build && pnpm --filter @tradeguard/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @tradeguard/extension typecheck && pnpm --filter @tradeguard/dashboard typecheck
